title: The Rain, 2001 · before
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Two days before the fourth Rain: the frame shop's back room, the dog on the blanket, and Wood at the window watching for it. It hasn't started. The strip waits with him.

panels.composition: The frame shop's back room. WOOD at the small window. BARNABY on the blanket.
